d5olo2010: Casimir Olo arrived with the Day 8 draft, carrying a frozen apple and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
Asked what he wanted after the war, Casimir Olo said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on.
emmettoftheknox: On the way to S-S10, Ulrich Emmettofthek tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Ulrich Emmettofthek (Concord) and Wendel Roma (Hegemony) spotted the same abandoned cart near Hill 304. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was.

Ulrich Emmettofthek has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich Emmettofthek. Ulrich Emmettofthek read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob of the Hegemony and Ulrich Emmettofthek of the Concord have been shooting at the same tin can on the wire at the Hanging Bridge for a week. Both trenches keep score.
Ulrich Emmettofthek spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.
gunpla_monster: Roland Monster took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

During a lull at Sorrow Copse, Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac called across from the Concord line. Roland Monster answered from the Hegemony side with a convincing imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet. The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Roland Monster looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A bullet went through Roland Monster's sleeve at S-F7 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks of the Concord (@csllgaks).

Roland Monster's wound turned bad. The bandage was not enough and he was carried back to wait for a bed. A letter from home found Roland Monster before the night shift. Roland Monster folded it small and kept it close.

Roland Monster spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Hill 304. Roland Monster folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
There was never a bed for Roland Monster, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-F7 on his own feet.
Roland Monster tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
Listening post, three in the morning. Roland Monster heard boots, then whispering, then nothing. Just a fox, the corporal said. He did not sleep afterwards.
A round went through the rim of Roland Monster's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Emil Majormalprac of the Concord (@majormalpractice_626).
kechy_ali09: Arno Ali reached R-S8 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine. Arno Ali's transfer to the role of sniper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

A newspaper reached Arno Ali with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well. A letter from home reached Arno Ali before dusk. Arno Ali read it twice and slept a little easier.
Arno Ali spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection. A letter from home reached Arno Ali before dusk. Arno Ali read it twice and slept a little easier.
Someone asked Arno Ali to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.

Arno Ali found an old map of the Hanging Bridge from before the war. There was a school on it, and an orchard. He looked for them. He did not find them. A letter from home reached Arno Ali before dusk. Arno Ali read it twice and slept a little easier.
mearsiecat: In Rosenau, Konrad Mearsiecat was a coal miner. In R-F3, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a coal miner again.
Konrad Mearsiecat borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.

Konrad Mearsiecat went out with the wiring party at R-F3. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into R-F3. Konrad Mearsiecat has learned to walk bent double.
A rat stole Konrad Mearsiecat's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Konrad Mearsiecat fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.
Konrad Mearsiecat checked the safety catch three times before handing over the post. The man taking over noticed, and checked it once more.
Konrad Mearsiecat began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.
mr.unstoppable213: Ulrich Unstoppable told the sergeant he was a coal miner. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
Ulrich Unstoppable fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Bastian Nodrag, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.

A supply man offered Ulrich Unstoppable a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records. Word came down the line: Hill 304 is ours. Ulrich Unstoppable shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Ulrich Unstoppable coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays an operatic duet nobody can translate, but something knocks once every revolution.
Ulrich Unstoppable had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Quentin Joshgentile crossed it, Ulrich Unstoppable fired. Quentin Joshgentile was badly wounded.
On dawn watch at R-F3, Ulrich Unstoppable fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Otto Geronimoleys, now gravely wounded.
The gramophone stopped knocking after Ulrich Unstoppable tightened a screw. The dugout applauded the repair halfway through an operatic duet nobody can translate, spoiling the best part.
zdawg_44: Henrik Zdawg arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a key to a house that is no longer there and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
zidane_mcnamara: In Tannenfeld, Edmund Mcnamara was a clockmaker. In S-S7, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a clockmaker again.

Edmund Mcnamara found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'. A letter from home found Edmund Mcnamara before the night shift. Edmund Mcnamara folded it small and kept it close.

Edmund Mcnamara brought sandbags forward and found the damage worse than the message had said. The party went back for another load. A letter from home found Edmund Mcnamara before the night shift. Edmund Mcnamara folded it small and kept it close. Edmund Mcnamara bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.' Edmund Mcnamara was invited to the Officers' Mess for keeping the front supplied. The colonel poured a real coffee and raised his cup: 'The front does not forget its friends.'

Edmund Mcnamara's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage. A letter from home found Edmund Mcnamara before the night shift. Edmund Mcnamara folded it small and kept it close.

Edmund Mcnamara found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful. A letter from home found Edmund Mcnamara before the night shift. Edmund Mcnamara folded it small and kept it close.
